Rhea (CSM): Heads-up — Spectra Analytics QBR next Monday. I noticed a sustained embedding + rerank spike since last Thursday after their Insights rollout. Need a 1-slide cost summary + asks.
Omar (FinOps): Pulling numbers now. 7d increase +160% vs baseline. Quick projection if steady: monthly ~$41k vs baseline $16k. Flagging potential renewal sensitivity.
alerts-bot: Budget alert: account spectra-analytics passed soft threshold (daily spend 6.1k) at 2026-04-24T08:22Z.
Eli (Solutions Eng): Likely causes: denser vector indexing and per-interaction rerank calls. Low-effort wins: switch non-critical flows to emb-small, enable client-side batching, and introduce a rerank sampling strategy.
Maya (Onboarding): I'll request sample logs + their deploy changelog and schedule a 30m enablement session for Wed. Can we provide a pre-meeting checklist for engineers?
Omar (FinOps): Quick modeled plays: A) throttle campaign routes (soft cap = avg*1.25, hard = avg*1.8), B) credits for 3 days to ease transition, C) move heavy analytics to nightly batch. Estimated savings if adopted: 30-55%.
Rhea (CSM): Please have the plays with conservative % savings for the slide. Also include a runway calc and a suggested credit ask. Maya, get logs asap.
Eli (Solutions Eng): Tech plays I'll propose: 1) Trial 512->256 embedding dim for UI queries (est -30%), 2) Batch embed calls size 32 (est -25%), 3) Rerank sample at 10% with cached top-K (est -40% for rerank cost). I'll draft examples and ETA EOD.
Maya (Onboarding): Invite sent for Wed 9:30 PT. Checklist in invite: top 500 queries, sample 2k embed calls, recent commits, and traffic segment info.
Omar (FinOps): Draft numbers I'll attach: baseline monthly $16,200; projected campaign month $41,000; mitigated projection w/plays $23,800. I'll also draft credit ask: 3-day offset covering 50% of expected overrun.
Spectra Success Admin: We'll prioritize the samples and confirm who's joining from engineering. The Insights feature launched Apr 22 and used a denser upsert script.
Rhea (CSM): For the QBR slide: 1) 30s incident summary + delta, 2) proposed plays w/estimated savings & owners, 3) enablement plan + timing, 4) asks (soft cap, short credit, follow-up).
Eli (Solutions Eng): If they need an immediate stop-gap we can enable route-level sampling: `PATCH /v1/accounts/spectra/routes/insights { "sample_rate": 0.2 }`
Omar (FinOps): Note — if runrate stays >2x baseline for 30d, mark as renewal risk in the QBR. I'll include sensitivity scenarios.
Rhea (CSM): Perfect. Action items: Omar -> final forecast + credit rec (EOD). Eli -> plays slide + conservative savings (EOD). Maya -> collect logs + run enablement Wed. I'll assemble deck and share draft tomorrow AM. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
